body:
Umbrella for the `expenses` list kind. The design and every reason behind it
is docs/archive/specs/2026-09-17-expense-lists-design.md; the tickets under
the `expenses` label carry the work and deliberately do not repeat the why.

Three phases, each a release:
1. expense lists exist and balance
2. the rules: close by unanimous vote, no leave while open, freeze, no delete
3. settlement suggestions

Decisions already made (do not reopen without the user): one item field
holds both share maps + date; amounts not percentages; one currency per list,
free text; `kind` fixed for life; closed is final; any member edits; account
deletion always allowed, departed members become "former member"; solo lists
fully supported.
title: Expense lists — a third list kind, Tricount-style (epic)
